svg.title: Architecture decisions, and what rests on what
svg.desc: Ten decisions, grouped by what they decide. An arrow means the decision it points at rests on the one behind it, so a decision cannot be reopened without reading what sits on top of it. Every card carries the date it was taken and the state it is in today.
